speaker: milo
text: Milo says “ciao” whenever he meets someone. Maren thinks Lexlings just copy our greetings.
The Drizzlet said “ciao” too, and again when it swam off.

speaker: milo
text: Milo says “fame” and rubs his belly right before he eats.
A wild Pebblit said “fame”, the same sound Milo makes. It isn't just a Milo thing.

speaker: puffkin
text: Pip thinks Bluster gets restless indoors. I'm not sure that's all it is.
When Milo says “guarda”, he's pointing at something. Every time.
The Puffkins in the trees said “guarda” and looked straight at Milo.
“Vieni”: Milo runs ahead and waits for me to catch up.
Milo says “acqua” around water. Streams, flasks, puddles.
Other Lexlings say “acqua” too.

speaker: emberhog
text: Emberhogs shout “fuoco” before certain attacks.

speaker: emberhog
text: Emberhogs yell something else before they charge: “all'attacco”.
When an Emberhog yells “all'attacco”, something solid in its way works wonders.
A Drizzlet said “attento” right before an Emberhog showed up. Milo says it too, when something's wrong.
“Terra” keeps coming up around dirt and stones.
Puffkins love a breeze. They never stop saying “vento”.
Lexlings say “grazie” after someone gives them something. Even the Emberhog did, when Milo fed it fire.
Milo says “bravo” when I get something right. The Drizzlet said it when I splashed it.
The Drizzlet asked “amico?” and Milo said it right back.
“Aspetta”: Milo says it right before he stops me. Or when he wants me to stay put while he goes ahead.

speaker: flickerwing
text: The Flickerwing said “ho paura” in the dark. “Ho fame”, “ho paura”... they start the same way.

speaker: flickerwing
text: “Non ho fame”, it said, and turned away from the berries. “Non” seems to flip things around.
The Flickerwing glows and says “luce”. The same word is carved on the stones in the Hollow.

speaker: writing
text: Lexlings write. There are words carved into the stones in the Old Hollow. Maren says that's impossible.
“Grande” comes right before the biggest attacks. Bluster's and Old Cinderback's both.
The Craglings and the old Emberhog all call Milo “il piccolo”. Milo called the Flickerwing that too.
“Con” goes between what Milo should do and what he should do it with. He perks up when I say it that way.
“Difendi”, and Milo puts up a shield instead of attacking. Against the biggest blasts, that's the only thing that works.
